title: Operating-system command executed from a string in erlang — review required
description: os:cmd passes its argument to the system shell. When the string contains request data, shell metacharacters append commands running with the Erlang node identity. The rule flags the call; whether the string is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Use open_port with an argument vector and no shell, and validate dynamic values.
limitation: Lexical: matches os:cmd calls; port-based execution is out of scope.
